add.title: Worktrees: when a worktree closes, don't commit regenerated files.jsonl indexes or the worktree's copies of shared logs as 'leftovers'
add.why: All 19 'unmerged' branches in ai/sessions/ready-to-merge.jsonl (2026-10-23) were only such leftover commits: a fresh worktree's dev server rewrites dozens of files.jsonl at boot, and agents append to the worktree's copies of shared logs (ai/cards.jsonl, ai/log.jsonl). Each became a fake leak the owner would have to judge. Servex/Worktrees.js (the close, near its ready-to-merge.jsonl append) could skip files.jsonl and append-only logs whose lines are already on the base, and only list a branch whose leftovers include real work. Resolutions: the set-aside lines at the end of ready-to-merge.jsonl.

add.title: WorktreeWatch: report a layout break only when the change caused it (compare with michael/dev), and tell the worktree's holder, not its parent
add.why: 2026-10-24 01:28Z: minion-item-tool edited code in qf-5; the watcher sent mastermind-page two 'breaks' for /framework/ and /framework/core/List/ (empty share 0.63 at 1920), but both pages render correctly. Their emptiness is the reading-width layout that is already on michael/dev, so the report says nothing about the save. Same rule as the test proposal in core/Page/tasks/page-mastermind/plan.md section 3: report pass->fail, not a standing state.

add.title: Pool: return_worktree on a slot whose git worktree is already removed should forget the slot, not refuse
add.why: 2026-10-23 23:07: qf-5 was merged and `git worktree remove`d. Its empty folder stays busy (a process still has it as cwd), so the sweep's existsSync check keeps the slot. return_worktree then refuses with 'uncommitted changes … fatal: not a git repository'. The slot stays 'taken by mastermind-page' in .worktree-pool.json until the folder can be deleted.

add.title: WorktreeWatch: flag an empty-share break only when the worktree is worse than michael/dev on the same page and width
add.why: Servex/WorktreeWatch.js:20 uses a fixed EMPTY_MAX 0.6, so a plain doc page (wide reading margin) warns on every save in any worktree. On 2026-10-24, five warnings on qf-9 (/framework/, core/Page, core/Router, AISession, sessions/doc/variants) all measured pages unchanged from michael/dev, and the shots looked normal. Compare against the main tree's own measure of that url (or skip urls the diff does not touch) before messaging the agent.

worktreewatch-flag-an-empty-share-break.stop: duplicate of worktreewatch-report-a-layout-break-only; kept only for its evidence (five unchanged pages warned on qf-9, 2026-10-24)
